Foundation in computer science, data structures, object-oriented programming, and software development lifecycle.

experience.desc: Led a cross-functional iOS team of 5–6 engineers delivering the My Verizon for Business app — serving 1M+ business users. Enforced Clean Architecture, TDD, and CI/CD via GitHub Actions and Fastlane, achieving a 30% performance uplift and 25% reduction in post-release defects.

Led iOS development across 5+ simultaneous products including a Vedic education platform (50,000+ users) and a Saudi market e-commerce application. Established CI/CD pipelines and mentored junior engineers across multiple product tracks.

Diagnosed and resolved critical app instability, achieving a 90% crash rate reduction. Delivered performance-critical features and built robust data persistence layers using Core Data and local caching strategies.
